description: Estimates the revenue a business loses each year to unanswered phone calls (missed calls, lost callers, lost customers, monthly and five-year loss) and how much an AI receptionist that answers every call could recover. Give calls per week (or missed calls per week) and the average job value; every other assumption has a sensible default.

average_job_value_usd.description: Average revenue from a new customer's first job or purchase.

close_rate.description: Share of new callers who become customers when answered, 0–1 (default 0.4).

customer_lifetime_value_usd.description: Optional: total revenue from a typical customer over time. Used instead of the average job value.

missed_per_week.description: Missed calls per week, if known. Overrides calls_per_week × missed_rate.

missed_rate.description: Share of calls that go unanswered, 0–1 (default 0.25).

new_caller_share.description: Share of missed callers who are new potential customers, 0–1 (default 0.5).

no_callback_rate.description: Share of those new callers who call a competitor instead of calling back, 0–1 (default 0.6).

recovery_rate.description: Share of lost calls an AI receptionist would handle, 0–1 (default 0.9).

name: calculate_missed_call_cost
title: Missed Call Cost Calculator
